QUOTE: "`_declared_index_scope` ... no `index_scope` section ──► None (fall through)" and "A section that is present but unusable is refused with exit 1 at build time (`cli._apply_scope`), rather than quietly falling back to the whole repository."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the declaration is preferred and that absence falls to the whole repository. But it says an unusable declaration is refused, not that every failure to find one falls through, which contradicts the item.
